home.title: {brandName} — check your manuscript before you submit
home.description: Bring a PDF, .docx, .tex or .bib. Every reference is checked against live scholarly databases and you get back the points a reviewer notices first.

features.title: Features — {brandName}
features.description: What {brandName} checks: reference accuracy, source discovery, abbreviation consistency and venue compliance, in one pass over your manuscript.

pricing.title: Pricing — {brandName}
pricing.description: What {brandName} costs and what a free run includes.

privacy.title: Privacy — {brandName}
privacy.description: What {brandName} receives, what stays in your browser and what is stored.

language.label: Language
language.more: More languages are on the way. Switching changes the whole interface and keeps you on this page.

workspace.title: Check your manuscript before you submit
workspace.lead: Drop a PDF, .docx, .tex or .md. {brandName} reads the text, checks every reference against live scholarly databases and shows you what a reviewer will notice first. Your bibliography, your glossary file and the venue's requirements go on the document's own card.
workspace.reloadLoses: Reloading this page loses the buffer: the extracted text lives in this tab only. Download anything you want to keep before you leave.
workspace.failedBody: Job {jobId} failed. Your documents are untouched — go back and try again.

dropzone.title: Drop your documents here
dropzone.formats: PDF · DOCX · TEX · BIB · GLS · MD · TXT
dropzone.limits: up to <v>{maxSizeMb} MB</v> each, <v>{maxDocuments}</v> texts in all, counting the ones your checks read

about.title: What {brandName} checks
about.footnote: Full Check runs every applicable check in one pass.

refusal.fileTooLarge: {name} is {sizeMb} MB, and the limit is {limitMb} MB per file.
refusal.tooMany: That would make {count} texts in the browser, and it holds {limit} — counting the bibliographies, glossaries and requirements your checks read.
refusal.docTooLarge: {name} has {chars} characters, and one document may have {limit}.
refusal.jobTooLarge: That would make {chars} characters in the buffer, and the limit is {limit}.
refusal.checkTooLarge: That would make {chars} characters for one check to read, counting the document and everything it reads alongside it, and the limit is {limit}.
refusal.attachmentTooLarge: {name} has {chars} characters, and a {slot} may have {limit}.
refusal.unsupported: {name} is a .{extension} file, which is not read. Bring it as PDF, Word, .txt, .md, .tex, .bib or .gls, or paste the text.

paste.title: Paste or type text
paste.fieldLabel: Text to add to the buffer
paste.nothingTyped: There is nothing to add yet — type or paste some text first.

buffer.heading: Buffer
buffer.nameOpensText: The name opens the text — read it and correct it before it is sent.
buffer.removeConfirm: {name}, its text and everything brought in on its card will be gone, and there is nowhere to get them back from.
buffer.clearConfirm: All {documents} documents and every edit you made will be gone. Download anything you want first.

announce.password: {name} is protected — a password field is on its card.

password.label: Password for {name}
password.hint: It is used here and travels nowhere — the document is read in this browser.

reason.FILE_UNREADABLE: This file could not be read. It may have been moved, renamed or changed since it was brought in.
reason.PDF_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: This PDF is protected. Enter its password and it will be read here.
reason.PDF_PASSWORD_WRONG: That password did not open this PDF.
reason.PDF_CORRUPT: This PDF could not be opened — the file looks damaged. Try again, or paste the text in.
reason.NO_TEXT_LAYER: No text found. {brandName} analyses text, and the pages of this document are images. Check that the document contains text rather than scans.
reason.DOCX_UNREADABLE: This file could not be opened as Word — it is either not a .docx or its container is damaged. Save it as PDF, or paste the text in.
reason.DOCX_EMPTY: This Word file opened and held no text.
reason.ARCHIVE_TOO_MANY_ENTRIES: This Word file holds {entries} parts, and the ceiling is {limit}. Load a PDF instead, or paste the text in.
reason.ARCHIVE_ENTRY_TOO_LARGE: A part of this Word file unpacks to {bytes} bytes, and the ceiling is {limit}. Load a PDF instead, or paste the text in.
reason.ARCHIVE_TOTAL_TOO_LARGE: The parts of this Word file unpack to {unpacked} bytes together, and the ceiling is {limit}. Load a PDF instead, or paste the text in.
reason.ARCHIVE_RATIO_TOO_HIGH: A part of this Word file unpacks to {unpacked} bytes from {packed}, past the ceiling of {limit} to one. Load a PDF instead, or paste the text in.
reason.TEXT_EMPTY: Nothing was extracted from this file.
reason.TEXT_SUSPICIOUS: The text came out badly — read it before the check runs.
reason.TEXT_BAD_ENCODING: The text came out badly: replacement characters are visible in it, so the file is not the UTF-8 it was read as. Correct it here, or save it again as UTF-8.
reason.PAGES_MISSING: {parsed} of {pages} pages were read. Work with what is here, or fill the rest in by hand.
reason.WORKER_TIMEOUT: Reading this document took too long and was stopped.
reason.WORKER_CRASHED: This document could not be read.

attach.dropHere: or drop a file here, or
attach.nothingPasted: There is nothing to attach yet — paste the text first.
attach.removeBody: {name} will be gone, and there is nowhere to get it back from. The check will still run, and will do less.

glossary.label: The glossary file you already have

state.failed: That address could not be read.

settings.unifyKeys: Rewrite citation keys to one format

sortOrders.author: By author

settings.citeWholeDocument: Cite will read this document from the first line to the last and propose sources for the claims it finds.

editor.readOnlyReason: Read-only here: an edit would move the findings, and recomputing where they point comes later. Edit before a run, or download the text.

plan.nothingToRun: Nothing ticked yet — tick a check above.

missing.bibcheck: it cannot say which references are missing or uncited without the bibliography this manuscript cites
missing.glossary: it cannot leave alone the acronyms you already defined without your existing glossary file

job.resultsAppear: results appear as each check finishes
job.nothingToSend: Nothing to send yet: add a document and tick at least one check on it.
job.textToSend: Text to be sent: {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}
job.accessLocked: Paid checks: access closed — free checks will still run
job.accessNoLimits: Within your access days there is no limit on runs or on documents in a run.
job.retryAfter: Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

results.heading: Check results
results.documentsChecked: {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} · checked {when}
results.scoresNotAveraged: Scores are never averaged — only these counters are added up.
results.finishedNote: This check is finished. You can still edit and download the text. To check again, start a new check from the drop zone; the new check starts with an empty buffer.
results.editedAfterRun: This text has been edited since the check ran. The lines, pages and quotes below point at the text as it was sent, so they may no longer match. Download gives back the text as it stands now.
results.notAnchoredText: This check read a different version of the text, so the findings below are listed without places. Request:
results.notAnchoredUnit: This check measured its places in a unit we do not accept, so the findings below are listed without them. Request:

cite.title: Cite · {name}
cite.lead: The claims that need a source, each with real candidates to review.
cite.acceptedCount: {count, plural, =0 {no sources accepted} one {# source accepted} other {# sources accepted}}
cite.checkedAgainst: The text this was checked against
cite.noClaims: Cite found nothing in this document that needs a source.
cite.disclaimerLead: These are real, reviewable sources — not proof that a source supports your claim.
cite.disclaimer: Read the article before you cite it.
cite.exportLabel: The sources you accepted are assembled into a .bib you can read and save in the editor.
cite.exportAction: {count, plural, =0 {Accept a source first} one {Open # accepted source} other {Open # accepted sources}}

results.newCheckConfirm: This destroys the documents, your edits and these results, and there is nowhere to get them back from. Download what you need first.
results.skipped: Not checked — there was nothing for this check to look at.
results.citeNoScore: Cite does not score a document — it either found candidates or it did not.
results.checkNoScore: This check reports findings without assigning a score.

severity.notRunLabel: {count, plural, one {check not run} other {checks not run}}

scout.lead: One topic or set of keywords — real papers from ten live databases.
scout.hidden: {count, plural, one {# hidden by your filters} other {# hidden by your filters}}
scout.author: Author contains
scout.nothingFound: Nothing came back for that. Try other words, or fewer of them.
scout.nothingLeft: Every source found is hidden by the filters above.
scout.offline: The search did not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
scout.export: {count, plural, =0 {Keep a source first} one {Export # source} other {Export # sources}}

diff.title: DiffChecker
diff.lead: Two versions, and what changed between them. The comparison runs in this tab and nothing is sent anywhere.
diff.bringBoth: Put a text in both panes — a file or pasted text — and the comparison starts on its own.
diff.stopped: The comparison was stopped. The two texts are here and can still be read and edited.
diff.changes: {count, plural, =0 {The two texts are identical} one {change} other {changes}}
diff.overLimit: These panes hold {left} and {right} lines, and comparison works up to {limit} lines a pane. Nothing has been cut — compare the parts you need instead.
diff.panesNote: Both panes take the formats the buffer takes, and the modified one comes back in the format it arrived in. Panes hold up to {limit} lines each.

description.bibcheck: BibCheck verifies bibliography records and citations against live scholarly databases.
description.glossary: Glossary finds abbreviation inconsistencies and prepares reusable LaTeX definitions.
description.presubmit: PreSubmit checks venue requirements, anonymity and submission readiness before you submit.
description.cite: Cite finds claims that need a source and proposes real candidates you can inspect before accepting.

benefit.before: The lock is shown before a check starts, never after you have filled in settings.
benefit.visible: Every candidate and result remains visible for you to inspect.
benefit.export: Generated citations and corrected files can be downloaded from the results.

reason.unknown: This check is not available on this account right now.

features.title: Everything {brandName} checks before you submit
features.lead: Bring your manuscript and its bibliography. {brandName} finds the references that do not exist, the keys that do not resolve, and the venue rules you are about to break — before a reviewer does.
features.intro: You do not pick a tool. You drop in what you have — a PDF, a .tex, a .bib — and {brandName} proposes the checks that fit those documents. Below is what those checks are, in case you want to read about one on its own.

pricing.title: Free during the pilot
pricing.lead: Pricing is being finalised. Full access is free while {brandName} is in its pilot phase.
pricing.planNote: Every check is available at no cost while the pilot runs. {free} have no usage limits at all.
pricing.footnote: Pricing will be announced here before any charges begin. No payment method is required during the pilot.

pricingPlan.cite: Cite — sources for the claims in your text
pricingPlan.download: Download in the format you brought: Word, BibTeX, LaTeX, Markdown, plain text

account.title: Your account
account.signInLead: An account is needed for the paid checks, and for nothing else. Signing in takes you to your provider and brings you back here.
account.freeWithoutAccount: The free checks need no account and have no usage limits at all.
account.signOutClears: Signing out clears this browser: the documents in the buffer, the findings on screen and everything read out of your files go with it.
account.yourDataBody: Deleting your account removes what our server holds about you. The documents you brought are a separate matter: they are read in this browser, never uploaded, and they are cleared when you sign out.
account.deleteBody: Your account, your sign-in and everything the server holds about you are deleted. Paid access ends with it. This cannot be undone.
account.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to keep checking — what is already on this screen stays here.

leaving.title: Leave {brandName} for a moment?
leaving.body: This opens another site and comes back as a fresh page, and the buffer does not survive that yet: {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} would be lost. Open a document and download it first if you want to keep it.

feedback.title: Report a problem
feedback.lead: Tell us what happened. We attach what the application was doing - and nothing from your documents.
feedback.messageLabel: What did you expect, and what happened instead?
feedback.messagePlaceholder: The page showed 47 references, but the file I downloaded had 46.
feedback.untickAny: untick anything you would rather keep
feedback.promise: No document text, file names, search queries or PDF passwords are included - ever, in this report or in the automatic ones.
feedback.failed: The report could not be sent. It is kept and goes at the next opportunity.
feedback.sent: Thank you. Quote this reference if you write to support:
